p: A wide banner illustration in exactly the style of the first reference image: deep near-black background densely filled with coral-red and pink hand-inked swirls radiating from the middle, a dark halo of fine dots around the subject. The subject is a pair of studio headphones, drawn correctly and believably with every part in the right place (padded headband, two ear cups, one coiled cable), centred in the picture, in the same finish as the subject in the second reference image. The swirls are flowing ribbons and droplets only: no circles with marks inside them, no shapes that look like letters, digits or symbols. No text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere.
